<thought>To find the required template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a transformation that breaks an aliphatic O‑H bond and forms an O‑Si bond on the given protected molecule. This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_broken": ["O-H"],
    "bonds_formed": ["O-Si"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
